heading: ITR-6 Excel Utility for AY 2026-27: Eligibility & Due Dates
tldr: The Income Tax Department has released the Excel utility for filing ITR-6 for Assessment Year (AY) 2026-27.
ITR-6 is specifically designed for companies that are not claiming any exemption under Section 11 of the Income Tax Act, 1961.
This utility simplifies the process for corporate taxpayers to prepare and submit their income tax returns electronically.
Key due dates for filing ITR-6 for AY 2026-27 generally fall in October, with variations for companies requiring a tax audit.
Timely filing is crucial to avoid penalties and ensure compliance with income tax regulations.
caption:
Attention, business owners and finance teams! The Income Tax Department just released a new tool to help companies file their income tax returns (ITR-6) for AY 2026-27. This makes preparing your company's taxes much simpler. If your company doesn't claim special tax exemptions, this is for you. Know the key dates to avoid late fees.
